name: Quasit
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The quasit can take a bonus action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (Speed 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or back into its true fiendish form. Its stats are the same in each form, except for the Speed changes noted. Anything it's wearing transforms with it, but not anything it's carrying. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claws (Bite in Toad Form)
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, or 6 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage in toad form. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The quasit casts the Invisibility spell on itself, requiring no spell components. In the spell, it uses Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

description: Quasits are impish demons bound into servitude as familiars, their favored toad or bat forms hiding a venomous, clawed true shape they revert to when cornered.
